# L4.7 — Clean-clone quickstart verification: the README quickstart executed verbatim as a test

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164v_L4.7__clean-clone-quickstart.md` · seq 164v · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.6b` · stacked on the L4.6b PR.

**Requirement ids:** `R-2.12.4` (docs half — the public repo's onboarding path stays honest); the round-4 charter "fully ready public open-source GitHub repo launch".

## What changed

- `README.md` — a `## Quickstart` section a newcomer can run:
  - `<!-- quickstart:begin -->`…`<!-- quickstart:end -->` — the hermetic
    block: `git clone` → `cargo build -p hharness-cli -p hharness-kernel` →
    `hh doctor` (`connectivity:"ok"`) → a first run over the real stdio
    binding (`hh-kernel serve` fed hello/open_session/`submit` of an
    `hh.submit` invoke/`read` frames) →
    `lifecycle.run.finished{status:"succeeded", stop_reason.kind:"completed"}`.
    `hello.client.kind:"cli"` — the closed `ClientKind` enum admits no
    `operator` variant (a SchemaViolation in the first rehearsal).
  - `<!-- quickstart-live:begin -->`…`<!-- quickstart-live:end -->` — the
    optional local-model run: `hh run start` on the committed fixture +
    a `/assembly/slots/model_port` override binding `hh/gateway_http`
    `openai-compatible@1` to `env:HH_LOCAL_BASE_URL`/`env:HH_LOCAL_MODEL`
    (coordinates by NAME only — the kernel resolves them). Documented
    honestly: the run reaches `lifecycle.run.finished`; the terminal
    outcome is the model's tool-call fidelity — a schema-violating
    answer finishes `format_failure`, recorded not hidden.
- `scripts/check-quickstart.sh` — clones HEAD into a temp dir, extracts
  the marked block from the **clone's** README and executes it verbatim
  (the one substitution: the public clone URL → the pinned local clone,
  so the block's own `git clone`/`cd` lines run unedited against this
  commit's tree). Asserts the documented outputs; exit 2 on a malformed
  or drifted block. Uncommitted edits are never tested — that is the
  point.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — the checker wired into the
  `build-test-drift` ubuntu leg only (one matrix leg suffices).
- `scripts/live-verify.sh` — new leg `quickstart-live` (ticket L4.7,
  provider `local-ollama`, names `HH_LOCAL_BASE_URL`+`HH_LOCAL_MODEL`):
  the same verbatim-extraction discipline on the live block under a
  scratch `HH_STORE_ROOT`/`HH_WORKSPACE_ROOT`; asserts `exit_class:ok` +
  a real `model.call.completed` + `lifecycle.run.finished` and records
  the terminal `stop_reason` verbatim in the assertions.
- `docs/build/reports/live/2026-10-23-quickstart-live.json` + transcript
  + `SPEND.jsonl` $0 debit (cumulative $25.259768 of $100 — local lane).

## The live leg

`scripts/live-verify.sh quickstart-live --budget 0` → **pass** —
`HH_LOCAL_BASE_URL`/`HH_LOCAL_MODEL` `provided: yes`; the verbatim block
made a real `model.call.requested`/`model.call.completed` pair over the
local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (qwen2.5:7b-instruct, USD 0) and the
run finished. The recorded terminal is `format_failure{count:3}` — the
local model kept calling `hh_submit` with a `text` arg the closed
surface schema rejects. That is the honest outcome the capstone's
`hh-cli` arm also observed (`2026-10-23-capstone-run-local`); the block
proves the wire leg, not a particular model's tool-call fidelity — the
assertions record the terminal verbatim.
